self_review.kind: self review; no subagents or judging models

findings.conclusion: Every final first writer reaches a real write AV at the same XCHG instruction after original return. Seven individual stores on the reused first slot are tested. Filter decision is computed with TLS still armed and gate held; the first barrier precedes returning EXECUTE_HANDLER, second follows stop while still holding gate, third follows unlock/TLS clear before the outer handler. Phase instrumentation is test-only blocking.

Fresh and prepared producers see the stopped state before taking the gate. Prechecked producer has already passed the first state check, takes the released gate but the second check prevents any store. All original calls return correctly. Late-stop negatives allow a second store attempt; skip-recheck negatives do likewise while stopped. The read-only page prevents successful second publication; all negative databases still contain only the valid 8-record prefix.

A separate test probe sets depth 1 and faults at the same write PC and address while writer1 is paused with its TLS authorization armed. Probe variants have no arm or a different armed destination. Both propagate to a narrowly scoped outer test observer. This probe is not a second integrated original invocation. Shared-context negatives admit both incorrectly. Per-role diagnostics are read at event barriers or after joining, and first-writer shared diagnostics are copied before the probe may run.

Separate ACK service returns busy with gate held at filter/unwind; after unlock it confirms already committed seq8 while capture remains INVALID. Consumer can read valid seq8 before stop, then rejects a split body completion and a delayed cursor completion spanning stop. This does not revoke previously accepted records and does not test a body copy concurrent with reuse of that same slot.

Main controller stays alive and releases all test events. All 97 targets cooperate with quit and join workers/service. No containment or forced cleanup occurred. This stage intentionally does not claim launcher-loss independence, production pause bounds, arbitrary lifetime or mapping/control-page failure recovery. Prior autonomous-lifetime evidence remains separate.

97 native attempts, 85 matched and 12 true failed assertions across two negative rounds, plus a separate missing-implementation preflight. Three successful builds retained: initial unexecuted build, first exercised build, final build adding per-thread exception-code diagnostics. The split-command duplicate output was corrected before any native execution. No failed native/build result reclassified or overwritten.

Independent script imports no tested modules; it checks archived inputs/executable hashes, raw process/phase/AV and commit-before-ACK records, and readonly copies of all 97 databases. Original database/WAL/SHM hashes unchanged. Every terminal proof is same_process_signaled, tail_unknown true. 382 offline product tests pass.

New owned variant should test abrupt writer-thread termination while holding the publication gate and controlled recovery/abandonment semantics, without pretending SEH finally runs on forced termination. Process survival, ACK liveness, consumer/ledger cutoff and truthful incomplete cleanup need a separate protocol before implementation. No arbitrary fault recovery, real ABI/identity, hot unload or CFG/CET claim; original breakpoint dual-role failure remains.
